cases.given: Ordinary cold: 30 minutes outside initiative, then 30 minutes through tactical and exploration scenes.
cases.proposedAdjudication: One completed cold unit and one DC12 CON save; no second clock starts when initiative does.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: 30 minutes ordinary cold then five minutes severe cold.
cases.proposedAdjudication: 1/2 + 1/2 = one unit; one save at the highest contributing DC15, then progress0.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: 30 minutes ordinary cold, nine minutes protected, then30 minutes ordinary cold.
cases.proposedAdjudication: The short gap pauses progress; one DC12 save after the second exposed half-hour.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: 30 minutes ordinary cold, ten uninterrupted hazard-free minutes, then30 minutes ordinary cold.
cases.proposedAdjudication: The ten safe minutes clear unfinished progress; final progress1/2 and no new save yet. Existing cold levels remain.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Three successive failed ordinary cold saves from cold0 and Exhaustion0.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Cold1 grants DEX-check disadvantage; cold2 also −10 Speed; entering cold3 adds exactly one global Exhaustion. A fourth failure adds a second Exhaustion, not cold4.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Cold3, Exhaustion1 and active Stoneback.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Stoneback suppresses the cold1 DEX disadvantage only. Global Exhaustion1 still disadvantages ability checks; cold2 Speed penalty and future Exhaustion gains remain.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Drink Stoneback at cold1; no recovery occurs before its four-hour deadline.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Penalty suppression starts after completed dose; at expiry it returns. Cold level and partial exposure never reset.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Stoneback expiry and a DEX task both occur at dose completion +14,400 seconds.
cases.proposedAdjudication: The dose has expired at that instant; cold1 disadvantage applies unless another actual protection remains. Do not add an Action before the deadline retroactively.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Drink at T0 and T+1h, staying cold1.
cases.proposedAdjudication: One suppressed profile while either dose lasts. First expiresT+4h, secondT+5h; no banked level or doubled potency.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Cold2 and heat2 persist; walk30, burden−10, Exhaustion2 halves Speed.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Use one climate−10 and burden−10 before half: (30−10−10)/2=5 feet. Do not apply cold and heat as −20 together.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Cold3/Exhaustion1 enters dry 20 °C shelter for 90 continuous minutes.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Cold falls3→2→1→0 at30/60/90 minutes. Exhaustion1 remains until its actual recovery. Exposure fraction clears after ten safe minutes.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Cold2 warms for29 minutes, returns to active cold, then starts a new shelter interval.
cases.proposedAdjudication: The incomplete recovery interval is lost; cold stays2 until a fresh 30 safe minutes. Removed prior levels would not return.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Frost Drakari in severe cold with a complete dry insulating outfit.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Both provide advantage but only one advantage die. No immunity or automatic successful save; existing disadvantage cancels normally.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: A winter outfit is melded during a form change while the new body is exposed to−5°C.
cases.proposedAdjudication: The inaccessible outfit no longer provides worn insulation. Resume the same personal cold progress; the transformation creates no new cold history.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: A body is soaked in5°C air, then equips genuinely dry insulation while still in5°C air.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Wet severe-cold exposure stops only when the actual body/covered clothing is no longer soaked or the protection truly meets the dry complete-outfit rule. Swapping only a cloak over a still-soaked body is insufficient.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Black-Dragon Shadow Cloak is genuinely worn when the wearer makes a climate CON save.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Its task bonus does not modify this save. It may aid an actual qualifying weather-arrangement task under its existing domains; its name grants no acid/cold resistance.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: CON+2, full reserve, no air for192 uninterrupted seconds.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Reserve180 then grace12; atT192 suffocation assigns living positive HP to0 through actual lifecycle. No damage, tempHP absorption or Wound roll is created.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: CON−2 body receives a full reserve then loses air.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Reserve floors at30 seconds; grace floors at6. Suffocation starts after36 deprived seconds, not a negative or zero reserve.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: CON+2 body spends100 of180 reserve, breathes forfive seconds, then loses air again.
cases.proposedAdjudication: The five actual breathing seconds pause depletion and end any active suffocation prohibition, but do not refill.80 reserve and12 grace remain.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Same body instead completes six uninterrupted seconds of actual breathing.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Refill reserve180 and grace12 from current CON; a future deprivation episode begins with those allowances.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: CON+2 body has used100 reserve seconds and changes to an explicitly nonbreathing body forone minute.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Pause at80 reserve and12 grace. Returning to a breathing body without air resumes those values; no free new breath from transformation.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: A full-reserve CON+2 creature has held its breath60 seconds and then performs a legally permitted exhaled breath attack.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Before that exhalation, spend remaining120 reserve. Grace12 remains; the attack still needs its actual cost, geometry and source permission.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: A water-breathing humanoid is submerged and tries an ordinary V spell without an underwater-speech permission.
cases.proposedAdjudication: This NEW proposed restriction rejects V casting; water breathing is not speech. No spell cost is paid for a declaration rejected before commitment. Actual underwater-speech exceptions retain their scope.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: A suffocating character has HP30 and tempHP20 when its grace expires.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Assign HP0; tempHP20 is retained but cannot stabilize or supply air. No numeric damage, Wound save or damage concentration check; zero-HP concentration loss follows actual rules.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: A suffocating dying character with one failure rolls natural20.
cases.proposedAdjudication: The proposed suffocation exception blocks1HP; clear successes, keep one failure and remain dying. No Decay-style Stable0 is inferred. This is an explicit consequential review question.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: A still-airless patient reaches three death-save successes and one failure.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Clear successes, keep one failure and remain dying under the proposed suffocation restriction. Do not add an extra death failure.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: A real Ritual Ward prevents suffocation-related actual death and its HP-blocked exception leaves Stable0.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Honor that exact replacement. If air is still unavailable six seconds later, deprivation enforcement endsStable; it adds no automatic death failure or damage. The actual normal death-save cadence resumes.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: A rescued unconscious patient is moved into air with a clear airway at0HP.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Suffocation prohibition ends immediately; no automatic HP or stabilization. A legal helper/feature can now stabilize/heal normally. Six actual breathing seconds restore reserve.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: A breathing Ranger Beast exhausts reserve and grace.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Use its actual immediate-death-at0 lifecycle and any truly eligible death replacement. Do not invent character death saves or a free companion resummon.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Field Tide Tea is active as a submerged creature exhausts its grace allowance.
cases.proposedAdjudication: No roll exists to gain+1 on; it adds neither breath seconds nor a rescue save. An actual current Athletics check can receive its Water bonus.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Enter a campfire atT0, leaveT1, reenterT3, remain throughT6.

cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Cross three connected engulfing-room squares within five seconds.
cases.proposedAdjudication: One 3d6 contact packet from that fire complex, not one per square. Another packet requires six elapsed seconds since the prior one and actual contact.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Alchemist’s fire is attached while the target also stands in a mundane campfire.
cases.proposedAdjudication: The reviewed attached Burning record and the separate new area contact source use their respective actual markers. Do not attach a duplicate generic tick to the area source. Existing ongoing-fire family competition remains intact.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: An adjacent helper spends an Action extinguishing attached Burning on a target still in a room fire.

cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: Spend one actual gallon and one Action on the reachable campfire square.

cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: The first clearance phase completed, then vent closes during the second phase.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Retain thin density; lose unfinished second-phase progress only. An extinguished source has no emission to make it dense merely from vent closure.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: A still-living suffocating creature legally becomes a truly nonbreathing body while at 0 HP.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Suppress suffocation prohibition and enforcement while that body does not need to breathe, preserving exhausted reserve/grace. No HP or stabilization is granted. An actual eligible healer can now recover HP. Reverting without air reactivates suffocation immediately; a form change does not create breath.

cases.given: Two different casters have equal opposing five-mph Storm Magic adjustments; the reduction was applied first to actual 22-mph wind.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Use the earlier active reduction: 17 mph. If it actually ends while the increase remains, use actual baseline 22 plus 5 = 27 mph. Do not add 5 to the formerly adjusted 17. A same-caster recast replaces that caster’s old adjustment rather than stacking residuals.
cases.status: authored-example; not runtime-tested or jointly accepted

cases.given: A previously nonbreathing creature with no stored breathing record becomes an ordinary CON+2 breathing body where no breathable medium is available.
cases.proposedAdjudication: Initialize reserve 0 and grace 12 once. Without actual respiration it begins suffocating after 12 seconds, not after a fabricated 180-second inhalation. Six continuous actual breathing seconds would establish the full reserve.
